chapters.title: Data Architecture
chapters.overview: Design a consistent XDM model that supports profile unification, segmentation, personalization, and activation without unnecessary ingestion or operational complexity.
topics: XDM foundations: class, field group, schema, dataset
Healthcare architect scenarios from your notes

chapters.title: Segmentation and Audiences
chapters.overview: Segmentation converts profile attributes, events, and related entity data into audience membership. The key exam skill is selecting evaluation method based on latency, query shape, data availability, and use case.

chapters.title: Profile and Identity
chapters.overview: Identity Service connects identity values into an identity graph. Real-Time Customer Profile uses that graph and profile fragments to construct a merged operational profile.
topics: Profile collapse, split, and identity graph changes

chapters.title: Governance, DULE, ABAC, and Consent
chapters.overview: Governance questions test whether you can distinguish the right to access data from the permitted use of data.
topics: DULE framework: labels + policies + marketing actions
Scenario: enabling ABAC on a field

chapters.title: Data Sources and Ingestion
chapters.overview: Ingestion questions test source compatibility, batch vs streaming behavior, Profile enablement, identity mapping, data correction, monitoring, throughput, and latency.
topics: What happens when incorrect data is ingested again?

chapters.title: Activation and Destinations
chapters.overview: Activation sends qualified audience/profile data to an external destination. Destination setup, audience selection, attribute mapping, schedule, governance, and monitoring are separate decisions.
topics: When activation fails: choose the correct fix
